organization.name: Project Nehemiah
organization.mission: A multi-phase Christ-centered ministry in Washington, D.C. helping individuals move from instability toward lasting growth through mentoring, spiritual formation, and practical support.
organization.address: 4224 Fort Dupont St. SE, Washington, DC 20020

whoWeServe.desc: Individuals returning home from incarceration, supported with structured mentoring, guidance, and a clear path toward long-term stability.
People overcoming addiction through accountability, community, and long-term support.
Walking alongside those facing housing barriers toward stability.
Mentoring young people through life challenges with support, structure, and positive community.

programPathway.description: Project Nehemiah is not a collection of services. It is a structured pathway that supports transformation over time. Most participants commit to a 6- to 12-month challenge alongside others.

phases.name: Renewal
phases.focus: Mentoring, connection, and early rebuilding support.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.focus: Spiritual readiness, emotional stability, and planning for what comes next.

phases.name: Purpose
phases.focus: Long-term growth, community integration, and sustained direction.

curricula.name: How People Change
curricula.desc: Helps participants understand the motivations behind their actions and shift unhealthy patterns toward a deeper love for God and others.

curricula.name: The Crossroads
curricula.desc: A biblical framework for navigating addiction and renewal, guided by a biblical counselor.

curricula.name: Instrument in the Redeemer's Hands
curricula.desc: Helps participants pursue lasting transformation and grow in awareness, responsibility, and relational impact.

giving.capitalCampaign: Project Nehemiah is building toward long-term sustainability through strategic growth, community partnerships, and future initiatives like the Nehemiah Cafe.

faqs.a: We're at 4224 Fort Dupont St. SE, Washington, DC 20020.
Our office is generally open Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Eastern. (Confirm exact hours with staff.)

Project Nehemiah is a Christ-centered reentry ministry helping returning citizens, people in recovery, those facing housing instability, and justice-involved youth move toward lasting stability through mentoring, spiritual formation, and practical support.

faqs.q: How do I join the program?
faqs.a: I can take your information and have a case manager reach out, or schedule an intake appointment for you right now.
We have several volunteer roles - mentors, system navigators, marketplace coaches, hospitality, administrative support, and media. I can sign you up and have our team follow up.
You can give at project-nehemiah.com/donate, or I can have a team member contact you about partnership and giving.
